propositions: normalize_ci_conclusion.sh is a shell script implementing a pure function f(CONCLUSION, FAILURE_OBSERVED) -> vote that must be ported to a stdlib-only Python entry point
The existing subprocess-driven contract test must be re-pointed at the Python entry point while preserving its full case table, and new direct unit tests must cover the function in-process
The gerrit-verify.yaml workflow sparse-checkout must be updated to fetch the new .py file path instead of the deleted .sh script, and the run invocation must call the Python entry point

The ported function must maintain exact behavioral equivalence: pass-through success/failure/cancelled, skipped with FAILURE_OBSERVED=false->success, skipped with FAILURE_OBSERVED=true->failure, empty/unrecognized->failure (fail-closed), and default FAILURE_OBSERVED to false
Output must always be in the domain {success, failure, cancelled} with no out-of-domain values
The Python entry point must have no external dependencies beyond stdlib so a single-file sparse-checkout can execute without package installation
